I never accept rides from strangers, and offers of rides often happen when I am out excercising. I'll admit it, my appearance when being active often warrants the pity. I look really terrible ( saggy sweatpants, faded shirt, hair is a mess, occaisional dry skin patch breakouts on my hands face, etc) and people think that I am homeless (the subject has come up more than once). When I politely refuse, they also probably think that I am mentally ill and can't care for myself as well, and some people have a hard time accepting "no" for an answer. The point is to burn calories by walking/jogging and accepting a ride would be pointless because I'm not really going anywhere. Explaining that is pretty awkward.

For this very reason, I would probably be entirely too chicken to offer someone a ride, as the person who looks needy could very well be trying to keep a low profile. Shoving myself into their space would give them attention that they'd rather not have and slow them up.
